title: Client apply_dao_ack does not bind ACK operation to outstanding request
description:
File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/address_assignment.rs
Perspective: correctness / security

ShortAddressAssignmentClient stores only eui64, assigned_short, last_ack bytes, and last_sequence. apply_dao_ack() checks expected_sequence, option EUI, raw-wire conflict, and status==Success, then writes result.assigned_short.

It does not record the outstanding operation. A Success RELEASE ACK with the expected sequence (assigned_short=None) is accepted and clears the installed short address even if the node sent ALLOCATE. A later genuine ALLOCATE ACK for that sequence then hits conflicting DAO-ACK for one sequence and the node is left unassigned.

Fix: remember the outstanding ALLOCATE/RELEASE with the expected sequence, and reject an ACK whose operation (or Success-with-address vs Success-without) does not match that request.
